import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Scatter plot: Price vs Megapixels by Brand
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                      c=df['model_year'], s=df['weight_grams']/10, 
                      alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis')
for i, brand in enumerate(df['brand']):
    ax1.annotate(brand, (df['megapixels'].iloc[i], df['price_usd'].iloc[i]),
                xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels (size=weight, color=year)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Model Year')

# 2. Bar plot: Average price by brand
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
price_by_brand = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax2.bar(range(len(price_by_brand)), price_by_brand.values)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(price_by_brand)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(price_by_brand.index, rotation=45)
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
for i, v in enumerate(price_by_brand.values):
    ax2.text(i, v + 50, f'${v:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Box plot: Price distribution by sensor type
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
sensor_order = df['sensor_type'].value_counts().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Sensor Type')
ax3.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax3.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Line plot: Camera specs over years
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
ax4.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['megapixels'], 'o-', label='Megapixels', linewidth=2)
ax4.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['max_iso']/1000, 's-', label='Max ISO (x1000)', linewidth=2)
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax4.set_ylabel('Value')
ax4.set_title('Camera Specs Over Years')
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Pie chart: Body type distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(body_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax5.pie(body_counts.values, labels=body_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('Body Type Distribution')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 6. Heatmap: Correlation matrix
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
numeric_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Feature Correlation Matrix')

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
